Brick Outbreak MVP 0.1.0
Validation: Linux x86_64 / Godot 4.6.3

PASS: 38 source gameplay checks.
PASS: Same 38 checks run against the exported macOS PCK using Linux Godot.
PASS: ZIP CRC, application plist, executable permissions.
PASS: Mach-O universal binary contains Intel x86_64 and Apple Silicon arm64.
PASS: Code signature load command present in each architecture.
PASS: OpenGL rendering captured and visually inspected; Chinese glyphs render.

NOT TESTED: Running the macOS executable on a Mac; macOS GPU performance;
Apple code-signature verification, Gatekeeper acceptance, notarization.
The application uses ad-hoc signing and is not Developer ID signed/notarized.
Graphics are procedural block-style placeholders, not the detailed reference model.
